text:
jamie: heads up — we started getting a burst of tail latency + a few dim-mismatch errors on /v1/embeddings for client-acct-42 around 10:02 UTC. baseline ~120ms, now p95 ~800ms and p99 ~2.4s. logs show occasional "dimension mismatch" and a Batcher warning. trace=abc123

marta: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and the model name? also which route are they hitting (embeddings default route or custom)? :eyes:

jamie: hitting embeddings route `embeddings-prod-us` with model param set by client to "embed-legacy-1536". sample curl:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-legacy-1536","input":["hello world" ] }'
```

jamie: load test showed spike when many concurrent small requests mixed with a few long ones. we saw these log lines: 

```
[2026-03-17T10:02:05Z] batcher: coalesce_window_ms=10 max_batch_size=128 dynslot=enabled shard=3
[2026-03-17T10:02:05Z] batcher: coalesced_batch_size=127
[2026-03-17T10:02:05Z] batcher: dim_check failed, request_id=xyz789 expected=1536 got=1024 -> drop
[2026-03-17T10:02:05Z] batcher: emitting partial batch (size=64) due to per-slot max_batch_size enforcement
```

tom: looks like dynamic batching slotting + per-shard max_batch_size is creating partial drains. partial batches -> more queueing for tail, and the dim_check failure suggests mixed model variants are getting coalesced. can you confirm whether the client sometimes sends "embed-legacy-1024" vs "1536"?

jamie: yes — client has a feature flag that toggles model variant; about 2% traffic goes to 1024 variant. they claim it should route to a separate model but routing config uses a generic embeddings route.

eli: repro idea: if slotting groups by request_size or arrival_time but not model_id, different-dim models can end up in same batch and trigger dim check fallback. current behavior: dim-check rejects entire request (returns 400) or drops into fallback queue? which one did you see?

jamie: we saw 400s for a handful and the batcher logged "dim_check failed" then proceeded to emit a smaller partial batch. so some requests got rejected, others just waited longer.

nina: two immediate mitigation options: 1) set max_batch_size=64 on the embedding route to reduce partial-batch amplification (reduces tail, may increase per-token cost); 2) enable model_id as a slotting key so dynbatch coalesces only same-dim requests. both are quick config flips.

eli: agree. also add a fast pre-check in router that inspects the "model" field and rejects mixing-dim requests at the coalescing layer with clearer error msg. currently dim-check happens later in the serving runtime which is noisy.

marta: can we get a quick snapshot of metrics? jamie, please run this small script from a client VM to reproduce (10s burst):

```bash
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"'$((i%50==0?"embed-legacy-1024":"embed-legacy-1536"))'","input":["test" ] }' &
done; wait
```

marta: that mixes ~2% of 1024 into 1536 on a couple requests; should reproduce tail and the dim-check logs.

tom: while we wait on repro, i'll check shard configs and recent deploys. eli — if we change coalesce_window_ms from 10 -> 5 and reduce max_batch_size to 64 will that be safe to flip in prod for a quick test?
\
eli: safe to flip incremental on canary. deploy-bot: please canary config change "embeddings-prod-us: max_batch_size=64, coalesce_window_ms=5" to 10% and monitor p99+errors for 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: embeddings-prod-us config update -> 10% rollout now (id=cfg-20260317-01).

jamie: thanks. i'll run the repro and post logs. if that mitigates we'll ask client to split routes long-term.

nina: long-term: add model_dim tag to request context and use it in dynbatch slotting + surface metric per-dim p99. also add a clearer 409/422 error for mixed-dim coalescing so clients know to pin model variants.

jamie: got repro logs attached, p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 420ms on canary. dim-mismatch 400s also disappeared on the canary shard. will coordinate with client to update routing. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

marta: awesome, leaving thread open for client rollout. if they need help splitting routes we can assist.
